item_specifications.special_feature: Non Skid Bottom, Orthopedic, Removable Cover

about_item: Cozy Sleep Surface: Featuring soft Striped-Checkered flannel fleece fabric and waterproof TPU; provide furry friends with a great sense of secured, upgrading their bedding with cozy style, allowing them to fall into a deep sleep faster

Orthopedic Support: The dog bed is specially designed with 3.5 inches high-density egg crate foam to provide furry friends a restful sleep and great pressure relief to reduce joint pain and arthritis discomfort
Minimalist Texture Design:Crafted with a unique blend of stripe and checker textures, this dog mat adds visual depth while maintaining a modern, minimalist aesthetic

More Options: Six colors are available, with each color featuring five standard sizes; M: 30''x20'' for pets up to 30 lbs, L: 36''x24'' for pets up to 50 lbs, XL: 42''x28'' for pets up to 70 lbs, XXL: 48''x30'' for pets up to 90 lbs, Jumbo: 56''x40'' for pets up to 140 lbs

Care Instructions: The removable cover of the dog bed is machine washable just simply machine wash and tumble dry; please note that the egg crate foam is not washable; as the foam is compressed it will take about seventy-two hours to expand

summary.text: Customers find the dog bed to be of great quality, with one mentioning their dog loves the pillow top. The bed is easy to assemble and remove for washing, and customers appreciate its comfort, softness, and value for money. They like its color, and one customer notes it provides better rest. The size receives mixed feedback - while it fits snugly in a 500-size plastic crate, one customer finds it too small for their pet.

other_countries_reviews.text: マットが膨らまないとか評価が低いレビューもあり購入するか迷いましたがXL大型犬のサイズでグレーカラーだけが安くなっててイヤな色では、ないので注文しました、翌日到着しました。圧縮されたマット(スポンジ)は、すぐ膨らみました^_^枕部分は、カバーの裏にファスナーがありそこに枕スポンジを入れます。購入して良かったです^_^ソファに居る事がほとんどだけで、わんこ専用の場所が出来て良かった！すぐ横になってました^_^その後の感想ソファに居ないなぁーって見ると横になってますね、専用ベッドを気に入ってくれて居心地いいみたいです^_^私達にとっては、大当たりのわんこグッズです♪夏用のひんやりカバーの販売を願ってます！
